feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 8 (y=0.07 m, ±0.065 m, 16 mm, 56.40) cut s-bend line loss to 0.05 per run and gave s-bend progress 0.1825, but slalom still lost the line once per run (max_error 0.0604 m, oscillation 0.131). Iteration 9 (y=0.067 m, same spread, 51.11) brought s-bend line loss back to 0.5 per run, so the row should stay at y=0.07 m. Iteration 7 (y=0.065 m, 35.77) lost slalom line and dropped s-bend progress to 0.04, which supports keeping the lead near 0.07 m. Iteration 6 (wheel_radius 0.04 m, 47.71) brought line loss back, so speed stays at 0.03 m. Slalom steering_oscillation has stayed at 0.13 to 0.14 at every row and spread tested (iterations 3 to 9), so it is not driven by geometry. The oval has been fixed at progress 0.115 and max_error about 0.061 m since iteration 1. What I compensated for: I kept kp 2.0, kd 0.10 and ki 0, and kept the five weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], so the signal stays within about ±2 at the wider spread. Next race: if slalom line loss is zero and max_error is below 0.06 m, keep ±0.08 m and y=0.07 m. If slalom line loss stays at 1 per run with the spread at ±0.08 m, the spread is not the trigger, so keep the geometry and test kd 0.15 in the controller instead. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.14 on s-bend or slalom, return the spread to ±0.065 m.
